(Incorporated in Guernsey with registered number 51576 under the provisions of The Companies (Guernsey) Law, 2008 as amended)
The Board of Directors of the Company are pleased to announce the results of the Company’s Annual General Meeting (“AGM”) held on Tuesday 22 September 2026:
Resolutions 1 to 11 were all passed as proposed, by a majority in excess of 99%.
Further details of the Company and its investments are available on the Baker Steel Capital Managers website: www.bakersteelcap.com
